description: Work out when a state's annual report or franchise tax is next due, the amount owed, and the late penalty. States that key the deadline to the formation anniversary or quarter need formationDate; without it the tool says so instead of guessing a date.

formationDate.description: The LLC's formation date as ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Required for anniversary- and quarter-based states.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

name: get_annual_report_deadline
title: Get the next annual-report deadline
